papers.title: Physical computing across magnetic and RF domains for passive wireless information retrieval
papers.summary: A passive physical computing system transforms local magnetic signals directly into RF backscatter. Analog encoding and receiver-side neural reconstruction enable wireless magnetic information retrieval without on-device digital signal processing.

papers.title: Event-based Visible Light Backscatter Communication System in Underwater Environment
papers.summary: An underwater communication system combines liquid-crystal polarization modulation with an event camera to recover reflected light signals. Event-driven decoding supports low-power data links for underwater Internet of Things devices.

preview.alt: Underwater visible light backscatter system showing the light source, event camera, submerged tag, and event-stream decoding pipeline.

papers.title: Mechanically programmable metasurface for ultralow-power subterahertz beam steering
papers.summary: A mechanically programmable metasurface steers subterahertz beams by adjusting its surface geometry. Mechanical latching retains beam states without holding power, supporting continuous steering, multiple beams, and beam tracking for directional wireless links.

papers.title: A low-power single-channel EEG sensor for fatigue monitoring and command interaction
papers.summary: A lightweight single-channel EEG sensor combines conformal dry electrodes, low-power backscatter communication, and neural signal reconstruction to support fatigue monitoring and hands-free command interaction.

papers.title: A magneto-mechanical bio-interface with ultra-low-power analog backscatter for inclusive cardiac monitoring
papers.summary: A wearable bio-interface converts heart-induced skin micro-vibrations into magnetic signals and transmits them through analog backscatter. The low-power design supports cardiac monitoring across diverse users without on-tag digitization or active radio transmission.

papers.title: Mighty: Towards Long-Range and High-Throughput Backscatter for Drones
papers.summary: Mighty combines a low-power backscatter radio with a lightweight video pipeline to reduce the energy cost of drone video streaming. It shifts demanding processing and communication work to the ground controller while supporting long-range, high-throughput wireless links.

papers.title: mmExpert: Integrating Large Language Models for Comprehensive mmWave Data Synthesis and Understanding
papers.summary: mmExpert is a scalable framework that generates diverse mmWave-language data from the world knowledge of large language models, replacing costly real-world data collection with electromagnetic simulation and domain randomization. Hierarchical action-description prompts and contrastive language-aligned pre-training connect mmWave signals with free-form text, and a versatile interpreter supports open-vocabulary understanding across diverse contexts, evaluated with curated question-answering and captioning benchmarks.

papers.title: Privacy Preserving Two Hand Reconstruction Using Millimeter Wave Radar for Sign Language Understanding
papers.summary: mmPRISM is a two-stage framework for privacy-preserving sign language understanding. It reconstructs a robust two-hand skeletal pose from raw 4D millimeter-wave radar data, then fuses the pose representation with the original features as input to a large language model for open-vocabulary, continuous sign language understanding, approaching vision-based benchmark performance without cameras.
